text.en:
The per diem for the members of the provincial boards of Abra, Camarines Norte, Marinduque,
Masbate and Romblon, shall be fixed hereafter in accordance with the provisions of section two thousand and
ninety-seven of the Administrative Code, repealing the second paragraph thereof.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 17, 1937.
